interface.name: zwwm_capture_access_v1

description.summary: unlock screen and window capture for trusted clients

interface.description:
zwwm_screencopy_view_manager_v1 and ext_zwwm_toplevels_v1 are hidden from ordinary clients. A client proves it runs as the session's user by sending the capture token: the bytes of the file named by the ZWWM_CAPTURE_TOKEN environment variable, which zwwm creates readable only by that user and rewrites at every start.
Registries list globals as they were when created, so after granted the client creates a new wl_registry: it announces both globals, which may then be bound. Access lasts until the client disconnects.

request.name: authenticate
request.description: Exactly one granted or denied event follows.
